pages.title: Team Directory
pages.summary: Leadership and team leads directory, with security and compliance unowned since Priyanka left in July.
pages.body:
Leadership and team leads. Full directory is in Rippling.

| Name | Role | Team | Reports to | Based in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Noor Haddad | CEO & co-founder | Exec | Board | Portland |
| Felix Arrowood | CTO & co-founder | Engineering | Noor Haddad | Portland |
| Wren Castellano | VP Sales | Sales | Noor Haddad | Austin |
| Tobias Mbeki | Head of Finance | Finance | Noor Haddad | Remote (Denver) |
| Ines Takahara | Head of People | People | Noor Haddad | Portland |
| Dmitri Solberg | Engineering Manager, Platform | Engineering | Felix Arrowood | Remote (Toronto) |
| Keiko Ferrante | Head of Customer Success | Support | Wren Castellano | Austin |
| Rafa Oyelaran | Product Marketing Lead | Marketing | Noor Haddad | Remote (Chicago) |
| Marisol Quint | RevOps Manager | Ops | Wren Castellano | Austin |

Security and compliance: no owner since Priyanka left in July. Felix is covering "for now".
